features.title: LG ThermaV R290 — Optional registers
features.description:
| Optional registers | Unit answers |
|---|:-:|
| Energy registers | {energy_registers} |
| Compressor modulation limit | {compressor_modulation_limit} |
| Power limit | {power_limit} |

✓ answers · ✗ no answer

Groups that answered and are safe to switch on are ticked. The power limit is not ticked even when it answers: whether the unit really keeps to the limit is not confirmed yet. The emergency operation button and the experimental registers are never ticked. Everything can be changed later under Configure.

energy_registers.name: Energy registers
energy_registers.description: Adds read-only sensors for electrical power, cumulative energy, demand vs. supply and thermal power from input registers 34-51 (32-bit values). Not every unit serves them: a unit that does not answer simply leaves the sensors without a value, and is asked again only every few polls.

data_description.energy_registers:
Adds 13 sensors, read only:

- **Electrical Power Total System** — W, whole system incl. backup heater (input 30035–36)
- **Electrical Power Heat Pump** — W (30037–38)
- **Electrical Energy Total / Space Heating / Space Cooling / DHW** — kWh counters (30039–46)
- **Demand vs Supply** — level 0–12, no unit (30047–48)
- **Thermal Power (Reported)** — W, the unit's own figure (30049–50)
- **Thermal Energy Space Heating** — kWh counter (30051–52)
- **COP (Reported)** — thermal ÷ electrical power of the heat pump
- **COP System (Reported)** — thermal ÷ electrical power of the whole system
- **COP (Calculated)** — flow rate × ΔT ÷ electrical power
- **COP Heating (Cumulative)** — thermal ÷ electrical energy for space heating

The unit's electrical figures tend to read high; for billing or a COP to rely on, use a separate meter.

compressor_modulation_limit.name: Compressor modulation limit
compressor_modulation_limit.description: Adds a slider (40-100 %) for the maximum compressor modulation, holding register 23. Not every unit serves it; while it does not answer the slider stays unavailable. Writing this register is only possible while this option is on.

data_description.compressor_modulation_limit:
Adds:

- **Max Compressor Modulation** — slider 40–100 % (holding 40024). How far the compressor may modulate; empty while no limit is set.

power_limit.name: Power limit
power_limit.description: Adds a switch (coil 6, "Wirkleistungsbegrenzung") that turns the unit's power limit on, and a box (0.1-25.0 kW, holding register 24) for the limit. Documented in the manual, but not every unit serves them; while they do not answer, both stay unavailable. Whether the unit actually keeps its power below the limit is not confirmed yet: check against a separate meter. Both can only be written while this option is on.

data_description.power_limit:
Adds:

- **Power Limit** — switch (coil 00007), turns the limit on
- **Max Electrical Power** — 0.1–25.0 kW (holding 40025), the limit

emergency_operation_button.name: Emergency operation button
emergency_operation_button.description: Adds a button that starts the unit's emergency operation (coil 5, "Auslöser Notaus-Betrieb"). Emergency operation typically heats with the backup heater and draws far more power than the heat pump. Coil 5 can only be written while this option is on.

data_description.emergency_operation_button:
Adds:

- **Start Emergency Operation** — button (coil 00006)

Whether it is possible shows in *Emergency Heating/Cooling Available* and *Emergency DHW Available*.

experimental_registers.name: Experimental registers
experimental_registers.description: Adds read-only sensors for 18 registers the device answers on but the manual does not document. Nothing is ever written to them. Meant for collecting data over time.

data_description.experimental_registers:
Adds 18 diagnostic sensors with the raw values of registers the manual does not document, read only:

- **Experimental Input 30015, 30018, 30064**
- **Experimental Holding 40011 … 40023, 40063, 40064**

A block the unit does not answer is not asked again until the next restart.

compressor_statistics.name: Compressor statistics
compressor_statistics.description: Counts compressor starts and run time and averages its speed, from the values polled anyway; nothing extra is read from the unit. Many short runs mean the unit is cycling, which costs efficiency and wear.

data_description.compressor_statistics:
Adds:

- **Compressor Starts** — a counter; starts per day or hour come from the statistics. Attribute: the last run's duration
- **Compressor Run Time** — hours, a counter
- **Compressor Average Speed** — rpm while running, today (reset at midnight)

All three are kept across restarts.

poll_statistics.name: Poll statistics
poll_statistics.description: Adds two diagnostic sensors: Poll Duration (how long a poll takes, in ms) and Bus Load (that time as a share of the poll interval, in %). For judging how much the bus carries, e.g. before shortening the poll interval. Nothing extra is read from the unit.

data_description.poll_statistics:
Adds 2 diagnostic sensors:

- **Poll Duration** — ms per poll, with the number of reads as attribute
- **Bus Load** — poll duration as % of the poll interval

error.link_settings_conflict: The device is already in use with different link settings

progress.detect: Checking which optional registers this unit answers on. A unit that does not serve a group stays silent, so this can take up to about 30 seconds.

external_meter.name: External electricity meter
external_meter.description: Pick sensors of your own electricity meter for the heat pump (e.g. from vzlogger or a smart plug), to compute COPs that do not rely on the unit's electrical figures, which tend to read high. Both are optional; leave a field empty to switch its sensors off.

data.external_energy_sensor: Energy sensor (Wh or kWh, a total counter)

data_description.external_power_sensor:
Adds:

- **COP (External Meter)** — thermal power from flow rate × ΔT ÷ this sensor's power, the COP of the moment; no value below 100 W
data_description.external_energy_sensor:
Adds:

- **Thermal Energy (Calculated)** — flow rate × ΔT added up over time, kWh
- **COP Cumulative (External Meter)** — that thermal energy ÷ this counter's growth, both counted from when this sensor is set: the seasonal performance factor (JAZ) over that period

Both are kept across restarts. Choosing another sensor starts a new period.
